title: —I have amended my life, have I not? he asked himself
html_source: He’s asking this as he knows he hasn’t. He thinks he is not enough but he knows it isn’t.

anchor.text: —I have amended my life, have I not? he asked himself
anchor.prefix: not had sincere sorrow for his sin? But the surest sign that his confession had been good and that he had had sincere sorrow for his sin was, he knew, the amendment of his life.
